title: Voice-driven narrative RPG
description: A Unity RPG-lite prototype where players communicate with characters using natural speech. I designed the dialogue pipeline, voice processing, NPC behaviour, transaction flows, logging, and evaluation.

title: IoT monitoring station
description: An ESP8266 environmental monitoring system with multiple sensors, MQTT communication, configurable thresholds, and a browser dashboard.

title: Prosody analysis tools
description: Python tools for extracting and comparing energy, pitch, pauses, voiced segments, and speaking activity to explore emotion-aware dialogue.

title: Desktop utility applications
description: Qt and PyQt6 applications with multi-screen interfaces, form validation, date and time selection, and external application integration.

title: Embedded & FPGA exercises
description: Interrupts, UART communication, digital audio filtering, parallel processing, and neural-network inference on a Zynq development board.
